tv_academy_philosophy_add_high_direction_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_direction_contribution value = var:tv_academy_philosophy_direction_value }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_direction_value >= 0 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_direction_contribution multiply = 0.00005 }
	}
	else = {
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_direction_contribution multiply = 0.00025 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_monthly_delta add = var:tv_academy_philosophy_direction_contribution }
}

tv_academy_philosophy_calculate_current_issue_monthly_delta_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 1 }
		tv_academy_philosophy_calculate_monthly_delta_meritocracy_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 2 }
		tv_academy_philosophy_calculate_monthly_delta_renaissance_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 3 }
		tv_academy_philosophy_calculate_monthly_delta_banking_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 4 }
		tv_academy_philosophy_calculate_monthly_delta_new_world_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 5 }
		tv_academy_philosophy_calculate_monthly_delta_printing_press_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 6 }
		tv_academy_philosophy_calculate_monthly_delta_confessionalism_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 7 }
		tv_academy_philosophy_calculate_monthly_delta_global_trade_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 8 }
		tv_academy_philosophy_calculate_monthly_delta_manufactories_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 9 }
		tv_academy_philosophy_calculate_monthly_delta_scientific_revolution_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_academy_philosophy_apply_monthly_debate_drift_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_phase ?= 1
			var:tv_academy_debate_current_node_type ?= 1
			tv_academy_philosophy_has_current_issue_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_academy_philosophy_current_issue_embraced_trigger = yes }
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending }
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_recess_notice_pending }
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_monthly_delta value = 0.01500 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_direction_contribution value = { value = average_country_literacy multiply = 0.00020 } }
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_monthly_delta add = var:tv_academy_philosophy_direction_contribution }
		tv_academy_philosophy_calculate_current_issue_monthly_delta_effect = yes
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_debate_position add = var:tv_academy_philosophy_monthly_delta }
		tv_academy_philosophy_check_debate_endpoint_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_academy_philosophy_check_debate_endpoint_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_phase ?= 1
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending }
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_debate_position >= 100
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_result_issue value = var:tv_academy_philosophy_current }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_result_kind value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_phase value = 0 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_research.43 days = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_phase ?= 1
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending }
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_debate_position <= 0
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_result_issue value = var:tv_academy_philosophy_current }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_result_kind value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_phase value = 0 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_research.44 days = 1 }
	}
}

tv_academy_philosophy_clear_debate_result_effect = {
	remove_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending
	remove_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_issue
	remove_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_kind
	remove_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_monthly_delta
	remove_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_direction_value
	remove_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_direction_contribution
}

tv_academy_philosophy_accept_meritocracy_effect = {
	every_owned_location = { change_institution_progress = { type = institution:meritocracy value = 100 } }
	research_advance = advance_type:meritocracy_advance
}

tv_academy_philosophy_apply_pending_acceptance_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_issue ?= 1 }
		tv_academy_philosophy_accept_meritocracy_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_issue ?= 2 }
		tv_academy_philosophy_accept_renaissance_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_issue ?= 3 }
		tv_academy_philosophy_accept_banking_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_issue ?= 4 }
		tv_academy_philosophy_accept_new_world_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_issue ?= 5 }
		tv_academy_philosophy_accept_printing_press_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_issue ?= 6 }
		tv_academy_philosophy_accept_confessionalism_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_issue ?= 7 }
		tv_academy_philosophy_accept_global_trade_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_issue ?= 8 }
		tv_academy_philosophy_accept_manufactories_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_issue ?= 9 }
		tv_academy_philosophy_accept_scientific_revolution_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_academy_philosophy_resolve_pending_acceptance_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending ?= 1
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_kind ?= 1
			tv_academy_philosophy_has_current_issue_trigger = yes
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_issue
		}
		tv_academy_philosophy_apply_pending_acceptance_effect = yes
		tv_academy_philosophy_advance_current_issue_effect = yes
		tv_academy_philosophy_enter_recess_effect = yes
		tv_academy_philosophy_clear_debate_result_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_academy_philosophy_resolve_pending_rejection_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending ?= 1
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_kind ?= 2
			tv_academy_philosophy_has_current_issue_trigger = yes
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_issue
		}
		tv_academy_philosophy_advance_current_issue_effect = yes
		tv_academy_philosophy_enter_recess_effect = yes
		tv_academy_philosophy_clear_debate_result_effect = yes
	}
}
